Theorem
[Existence and uniqueness on a noncompact manifold, fixed metric] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0322 1. ch24:24.39\group Noncompact Heat Kernels

Every, not necessarily complete, noncompact Riemannian manifold has a unique minimal positive fundamental solution $H_{\mathcal M}(x,y,t)$ of the heat equation. It is smooth and symmetric in $x,y$.
